extract_backtranslations: extract back-translations from fairseq-generate stdout into source and target language files
filter_by_length: filter back-translation pairs by minimum and maximum token length constraints
filter_by_ratio: filter back-translation pairs by source to target length ratio threshold
parse_fairseq_output: parse fairseq-generate output lines starting with S- and H- prefixes
validate_translation_pairs: validate source and target translation pairs against length and ratio filters
